description: NSF #1537788: Enabling Next Generation Hybridized Wood Buildings for Resilient and Sustainable Construction is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Thang Dao, University of Alabama (ua.edu). In this project, the seismic behavior and optimization of a hybridized self-centering wood system termed a CLT-LiFS that uses unbonded post-tensioning tendons, cross-laminated timber (CLT) rocking walls and light-frame wood systems (LiFS) were investigated to enable the design of tall wood buildings that are sustainable and resilient. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-a0e6-w164. Keywords: CLT, Lightframe Wood, Hybrid Structures, Wood buildings. Published 2020-01-03. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
